items.name: MvPolynomial.hom_eval₂
items.type: {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {S₂ : Type w} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [CommSemiring S₂] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (f : R →+* S₁) (φ : S₁ →+* S₂) (g : σ → S₁) : φ (MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g p) = MvPolynomial.eval₂ (φ.comp f) (fun i => φ (g i)) p
